Game Overview

In Quiz Against Time, the core idea is straightforward: race against the clock in "Quiz Against Time," where your knowledge and speed are put to the test. Answer 50 diverse questions under increasing pressure, making only three mistakes. Sharpen your quick-thinking skills and enjoy an exhilarating quiz adventure filled with thrills and educational fun.
